card: Adds functional test cases in p2p_leak.py and p2p_sendtxrcncl.py asserting that peers advertising protocol version 70016 receive WTXIDRELAY, SENDADDRV2, and SENDTXRCNCL messages. Existing tests checked version 70015 to confirm feature negotiation messages were withheld, but did not test the exact threshold boundary. This protects against off-by-one boundary regressions in net_processing where greater-than-or-equal comparisons could be changed to strictly greater-than.
evidence: Author notes the tests kill mutation test surviving mutants in net_processing.cpp lines 3462, 3464, and 3466 by catching off-by-one comparisons on greatest_common_version >= WTXID_RELAY_VERSION (PR description).
problem: Existing functional tests checked that peers advertising version 70015 did not receive WTXIDRELAY, SENDADDRV2, or SENDTXRCNCL, but no test asserted behavior at the exact threshold version 70016. An off-by-one bug in net_processing changing `>= WTXID_RELAY_VERSION` to `>` would not be caught by existing tests.
scope_notes: Small functional test change affecting only p2p_leak.py and p2p_sendtxrcncl.py.
summary: Adds functional test coverage for the protocol version 70016 (WTXID_RELAY_VERSION) boundary in p2p_leak.py and p2p_sendtxrcncl.py. The added test cases verify that peers advertising exactly version 70016 receive WTXIDRELAY, SENDADDRV2, and SENDTXRCNCL messages.
